interpretation.records_without_article: Mostly verbs, adjectives, adverbs, phrases and proper names; part-of-speech classification is required before treating these as missing noun articles.
interpretation.noun_records_with_article_but_no_plural: 98 records have an article but no plural field. These include mass/uncountable and collective nouns, month names, and some context-specific forms; the list requires per-word classification rather than automatic plural generation.
interpretation.duplicate_policy: Exact/normalized duplicate rows are consolidated; source provenance remains attached to the canonical record.
interpretation.confidence_status: reviewed_draft means included in a second-stage review batch, not individually guaranteed. source_checked means a targeted correction was checked against the cited source. needs_verification must never be displayed as verified.
